Study: SFT-301 (Velorantib in moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis)
Site: 104, Mumbai
Subject ID: 104-0217    Initials: R.K.    Age: 54 years    Sex: Female
Visit date: 16-Mar-2026

Medical history: Hypertension, controlled on amlodipine 5 mg once daily. No known drug allergies.

Study treatment: Velorantib 50 mg orally once daily, started on 02-Mar-2026.

Presenting complaint: Subject attended an unscheduled visit with a widespread itchy rash.
Rash first noted on 14-Mar-2026 according to the subject at today's visit.
On examination: erythematous maculopapular rash, grade 3, on trunk and arms, covering
approximately 40% of body surface area. No mucosal involvement. Temperature 37.9 C.

Assessment and plan
Event: generalised maculopapular rash, CTCAE grade 3.
The subject was admitted to hospital on 16-Mar-2026 for observation and IV management.
Seriousness: hospitalisation.
Study drug interrupted on 16-Mar-2026 (last dose 15-Mar-2026).
Treatment: IV methylprednisolone 40 mg daily and oral cetirizine 10 mg once daily.
Outcome at time of report: not yet recovered.

Investigator: Dr. Anjali Mehta, Principal Investigator, Site 104
Received by sponsor drug safety: 16-Mar-2026

PATIENT DIARY - Study SFT-301 - Subject 104-0217
Week 2

10 Mar 2026: Took tablet in the morning with breakfast. Felt fine.
11 Mar 2026: Took tablet. Mild headache in the evening, went away after rest.
12 Mar 2026: Took tablet. Itchy red spots started on my stomach in the evening.
13 Mar 2026: Took tablet. Spots spreading to arms, very itchy, could not sleep well.
14 Mar 2026: Took tablet. Rash worse, showed my daughter. Called the study nurse.
15 Mar 2026: Took tablet. Rash on chest, back and both arms. Feeling feverish.
16 Mar 2026: Did not take tablet. Went to the hospital clinic as the nurse told me.

CENTRAL LABORATORY REPORT
Study: SFT-301    Subject: 104-0217    Site: 104
Sample collected: 16-Mar-2026 09:40

Haematology
Eosinophils 1.2 x10^9/L (ref 0.0-0.5) HIGH
WBC 9.8 x10^9/L (ref 4.0-11.0)
Haemoglobin 12.9 g/dL (ref 12.0-15.5)

Biochemistry
ALT 38 U/L (ref 7-56)
Creatinine 0.8 mg/dL (ref 0.6-1.1)

Comment: Eosinophilia noted. Liver and renal function within normal limits.

SITE 104 - RESPONSE TO SPONSOR SAFETY QUERIES
Study: SFT-301    Subject: 104-0217    Date of response: 26-Mar-2026

1. Onset date: After reviewing the diary with the subject, the investigator confirms that the rash first appeared on 12-Mar-2026. The date of 14-Mar-2026 in the clinic note was the date the subject first reported the rash to the site.
2. Dechallenge: After study drug interruption the rash improved within 4 days. Dechallenge positive.
3. Outcome: Recovered. The rash resolved completely on 24-Mar-2026. The subject was discharged from hospital on 20-Mar-2026.
4. Rechallenge: Study drug has not been restarted.
5. Causality: The investigator assesses the rash as probably related to Velorantib.

Dr. Anjali Mehta, Principal Investigator, Site 104
